titlePlain: Case Study: Choosing Between Three Real Vector
subtitle: Lesson 10 · Architecture Decision-Making

eyebrow: Three real options, three different philosophies
code:
Pinecone:  fully managed, cloud-native.
           No servers to run. "Buy" end
           of the spectrum.

Weaviate:  open-source, self-hosted OR
           managed. Hybrid search. A
           genuine middle position.

pgvector:  a Postgres extension. No new
           system at all -- closest to "build."
caption: Closing this chapter by applying all of it -- trade-offs, build-vs-buy, a design doc, and an ADR.

eyebrow: Scoring the options -- honestly, as a judgment call
code:
weights = cost .30, latency .20,
          operational_simplicity .30,
          feature_fit .20

Pinecone: weighted score = 7.40
Weaviate: weighted score = 7.50
pgvector: weighted score = 6.90
caption: These are Northbeam's own scores for THEIR situation -- not a universal ranking of these products.

eyebrow: Weaviate edges out Pinecone -- for this team
code:
Northbeam: cost-sensitive, small team,
needs hybrid search + metadata filtering.
→ Weaviate.

A smaller team with zero appetite to
operate anything, weighting operational
simplicity heavily, could legitimately
score Pinecone higher instead.
caption: Different company, different weights, different right answer -- not a mistake, a different situation.
